about: The shortcuts Settings › Messages offers for quick text, texting someone from any app (src/lib/quickText.ts), and the ones the backend will register (src-tauri/src/quick_text/mod.rs). Both test suites read this file, so the two lists can't drift. First is the default. No Ctrl+Alt (that's AltGr on many keyboard layouts) and nothing as well known as Ctrl+Shift+T.
